description: Monitor the email security setup of a list of domains (items) and send updates to your webhook_url. POST /v1/watch. $0.30 USDC on Base per call. Covers up to 25 domains for 30 days; SPF, DMARC, DKIM, MX and score are re-checked about once a day. For a one-time score, use /v1/score ($0.01). [x402: pays from the caller's wallet (X402_PRIVATE_KEY); without a key the tool returns the live 402 price only.]
name: mailsecuritytools_watch
title: Mail Security Tools API: POST /v1/watch
